title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE ACT ON SPECIAL CASES CONCERNING BUDGET AND ACCOUNTS
full_text:
Article 1 (Definition) "Reserve fund required for the activities of national security" referred to in Article 2 of the Act on Special Cases Concerning Budget and Accounts (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") means expenses required for the collection and processing of important information at home and abroad related to national safety and for the antinational criminal investigation of vital importance to the destiny of the nation and expenses for the reinforcement of military installations and equipment belonging to classified secrets and involving them, and which is determined through a resolution of the National Assembly.
  [This Article Wholly Amended on Nov. 23, 1974]

Article 2 (Application for use of reserve fund) In the application for use of the reserve fund referred to in Article 2 of the Act, the basis for calculation of the total amount shall not be indicated in it, and the reserve fund shall be the uses for it.

Article 3 (Allotment of reserve fund) The Minister of Planning and Budget shall allot the reserve fund referred to in the preceding provisions without classifying by subdivisions or items. <Amended on Dec. 23, 1994; Feb. 28, 1998; May 24, 1999; Feb. 29, 2008; Dec. 30, 2025>

Article 4 (Disbursement) Where the Minister of Planning and Budget disburses the reserve funds allotted under the preceding provisions, he or she shall, at the request of the head of the agency using the expenses, disburse it in total. <Amended on Dec. 23, 1994; Feb. 28, 1998; May 24, 1999; Feb. 29, 2008; Dec. 30, 2025>

Article 5 (Protocol of use of reserve fund) In the protocol of use of the reserve fund disbursed under the preceding provisions, only the total amount disbursed shall be marked.
